sentence: This project studies how a cell takes in molecules through its plasma membrane and how actin assembly is involved.
This project builds medical large vision language models that make fewer factually incorrect medical analysis results.
This project studies how skeletal muscle extracellular matrix and fibroadipogenic progenitor cells communicate to drive fibrosis in muscular disease.
This project tries to find drug leads that treat inflammation from acute lung injury without antagonist tolerance, using a machine learning model.
This project studies why immunotherapy often fails in pancreatic cancer, focusing on the liver, using mouse models and human tissues.
This project studies the role of macrophages in the development, maintenance and repair of the tympanic membrane, also called the eardrum.
This project studies whether a protein called interferon drives hyperhemolysis, a transfusion reaction that destroys red cells in patients with sickle cell disease.
This project studies how host mutations, tumor mutations and tumor microenvironment features drive response or resistance to therapy in breast cancer.
This project tries to improve retinal gene therapy delivered by suprachoroidal injection of adeno-associated viruses in nonhuman primates.
This project studies how primary care providers understand and address non-medical health factors in outpatient clinics.
This project builds data management systems and provides statistical support for research that aims to reduce stillbirth.
This project studies whether clonal mutations and coagulation biomarkers are linked to bleeding and venous-thromboembolism in patients with acute myeloid leukemia.
This project provides tools that measure low levels of volatile organic compounds and other markers of exposure to see how they affect human health.
This project studies how chemotherapy changes the activity of a fusion transcription factor in Ewing sarcoma, a childhood bone cancer.
This project studies how a CRISPR-Cas immune system forms immunological memory and why that memory matters during defense and tolerance.
This project studies which gene controls lung metastasis, found through a genome-wide CRISPR-Cas9 screen.
This project builds versions of an adeno-associated viral capsid that binds the transferrin receptor and avoids neutralization by pre-existing antibodies.
This project uses metagenomics and metaproteomics to find how dietary protein, fiber and the gut microbiota affect inflammation in inflammatory bowel diseases.
This project studies how neural circuits shape drug seeking during cocaine self-administration in a mouse model of HIV infection.
This project studies how HIV assembles and incorporates its envelope.
